title: Persona 3 Portable
provenance: Reported by jonnythekid28 (highball-db#1309, 2026-11-18), Apple M3 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 4 of 5 after 29 minutes: sound through headphones had a problem at first, gone after one restart. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: ATLUS's 2023 PC release of the PSP game. Persona 3 Reload has its own page. Reported playable with minor issues on an M3 Pro with DXMT on the default engine r28 over 29 minutes, a problem with sound through headphones going away after one restart.

knownIssues.symptom: A problem with sound through headphones at first (M3 Pro, DXMT, Wine 10 r28, highball-db#1309)
knownIssues.fix: it went away after one restart for the reporter
